_about: PC authored rival builds (spark combat-system-depth WP2, owner 2026-10-23: 'Rivals will have authored builds'). Read by arena/archetypes.ts; a build spawns through createGames(..., { rivalBuild: '<id>' }) on its wave, and rivals.json names Brennic's and Lio's builds for schoolRivals 'named'. Per build: school (fire|air), archetype (close: the brawler, holds inside its short rows; light: the fast caster, peaks at tiers 0-II and kites at its bolt's reach; heavy: the long-range controller, banks for and casts its tier III-IV rows), wave (0-based Tiro mage wave: 2 semifinal, 3 final; the spawn's competence stays the wave's), ranks (vigor, focus, nerve, agility, each 1-5), spellRanks (spell id -> 1-4 for the build's own bolt and slots; rank 5 is WP3's ultimates), loadout (bolt = <school>_bolt, slots = four distinct rows of that school). Stats follow the archetype: heavy high vigor/focus and agility 1, light high agility, close vigor/nerve. Unknown keys and out-of-shape values fail at load.
